cards.title: Ad account audit order: data → structure → creative
cards.summary: A prioritization sequence for auditing underperforming paid ad accounts: fix data integrity first, then account structure, then creative.
cards.use_when: Diagnosing a declining or flat paid acquisition program (Meta/Google) and deciding which fix to tackle first this quarter.
steps: Start with data integrity: verify tracking, pixel/events, attribution windows and reporting so decisions rest on trustworthy numbers. The source treats this as the highest commercial-impact item and the foundation for everything downstream.
Second, review account structure: campaign/ad set organization, budget allocation, consolidation vs fragmentation — the source places this as the number-two priority by commercial impact.
Third, move to creative: only once the data and structure are sound does creative testing become a reliable lever.

Note the source's distinction: by commercial impact the ranking is data, account structure, creative — but by time-to-implement the practical order is often data first, then account structure, then creative.
Apply the sequence as a recovery roadmap when a brand is going sideways or declining, rather than jumping straight to new creative.
caveats: This ordering is the presenter's framework/opinion, not a universal law; some accounts with obviously broken creative may warrant a different entry point.
The source describes its audit process at a high level in this section and does not detail the specific checks inside each phase.
